sources.projections: Sleeper weekly projections weeks 10-14, re-scored with league scoring_settings

teams.blurb: Top of both halves of the formula: Win-Now #1 and Dynasty #2. The 14-3-1 record comes with the #1 points total and a 61-19 all-play mark; the rest-of-season projection ranks #1, the best in the league. Jahmyr Gibbs, Malik Nabers and Matthew Golden lead the roster value; it's one of the two youngest cores in the league by value. Malik Willis is on IR.

The roster carries this ranking: Dynasty #1, built on Ja'Marr Chase, Brock Bowers and Jordan Love, outweighs a Win-Now rank of only #4. The 9-9 record comes with the #2 points total and a 50-31 all-play mark; the rest-of-season projection ranks #5. Injuries are the story: Jeremiyah Love, Davante Adams and Terrance Ferguson are all on IR, and TreVeyon Henderson is questionable; the Week 9 trade for Derrick Henry and 2027 R2 (Taylor's) is already priced in.

Win-Now #3 and Dynasty #5 land this team right about here. The 13-5 record comes with the #4 points total and a 40-41 all-play mark, so the record flatters it; the rest-of-season projection ranks #3. Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Caleb Williams and Kenneth Walker III lead the roster value. Terry McLaurin and Jacory Croskey-Merritt are on IR.

The roster carries this ranking: Dynasty #3, built on Josh Allen, CeeDee Lamb and Trey McBride, outweighs a Win-Now rank of only #6. The 7-10-1 record comes with the #7 points total and a 40-40 all-play mark; the rest-of-season projection ranks #7. Injuries are the story: RJ Harvey and Ricky Pearsall are on IR, and Jaylen Waddle is out with a concussion heading into Denver's bye.

Win-Now #5 and Dynasty #6 land this team right about here. The 9-9 record comes with the #6 points total and a 42-39 all-play mark; the rest-of-season projection ranks #4. Amon-Ra St. Brown, Jonathan Taylor and Tee Higgins lead the roster value; it's one of the two oldest cores in the league by value. De'Von Achane and Romeo Doubs are on IR, and Sam Darnold is out.

This is a win-now ranking: Win-Now #2 is propping up a Dynasty value that ranks only #9. The 9-9 record comes with the #3 points total and a 42-39 all-play mark; the rest-of-season projection ranks #2. Bijan Robinson, Joe Burrow and Trevor Lawrence lead the roster value; only 3 future picks left after trading some away holds down the dynasty side. David Montgomery is questionable and nearing a return; Michael Pittman Jr. is on IR.

The roster carries this ranking: Dynasty #4, built on Drake Maye, Luther Burden III and Tetairoa McMillan, outweighs a Win-Now rank of only #9. The 6-12 record comes with the #9 points total and a 29-52 all-play mark, so the record is earned; the rest-of-season projection ranks #10, near the bottom. It's one of the two youngest cores in the league by value; a stockpile of 12 future picks adds dynasty value. Injuries are the story: Travis Etienne Jr., Alec Pierce, Jayden Higgins and Jonathon Brooks are on IR, and Kyle Monangai is out, while Carnell Tate is expected back in Week 10; the Week 8 trade for Baker Mayfield, 2027 R3 (Mike's) and 2028 R1 (Mike's) is already priced in.

Win-Now #7 and Dynasty #8 land this team right about here. The 8-10 record comes with the #8 points total and a 37-44 all-play mark; the rest-of-season projection ranks #6. Jayden Daniels, Fernando Mendoza and Chase Brown lead the roster value. Mike Evans is questionable but not expected to play this week; the Week 9 trade for Jameson Williams is already priced in.

Dynasty #7, built on Justin Jefferson, Brock Purdy and Ashton Jeanty, is the only thing keeping this team out of the basement; Win-Now ranks #10. The 4-14 record comes with the #10 points total and a 21-60 all-play mark, so the record is earned; the rest-of-season projection ranks #9, near the bottom. Jaxson Dart and Michael Wilson are on IR; the Week 9 trade for Adonai Mitchell and 2027 R1 (Mike's) is already priced in.

Nothing in the formula props this team up: Win-Now #8, Dynasty #10. The 10-8 record comes with the #5 points total and a 42-39 all-play mark; the rest-of-season projection ranks #8. Puka Nacua, Lamar Jackson and James Cook III lead the roster value; it's one of the two oldest cores in the league by value; no future picks left after trading them away holds down the dynasty side. Injuries are the story: Lamar Jackson and Jalen Hurts are on IR, and DeVonta Smith and Josh Jacobs are out; Puka Nacua is doubtful. The Week 8 trade for Justin Herbert is already priced in.
